headline: Pierrakakis: "The progress of the economy paves the way for the next step"
summary: Finance Minister Pierrakakis presented the performance of the Greek economy, highlighting digitalisation, investment and debt de-escalation. He framed the progress as a basis for the next policy step.
why: Greece's fiscal path, debt levels and investment outlook matter for European sovereign bond investors and the broader euro-area periphery.
